Sourced from certified organic farms in Rajasthan, India. KSM-66® extract - the most clinically studied form of ashwagandha available. Shown to reduce cortisol, improve focus, and support deep sleep. In every formula we make.

WHY IT’S IN: Lowers cortisol without dulling the day. 600 mg daily.

settings.heading: 02 · MAGNESIUM GLYCINATE
settings.headingcontent: Magnesium. The mineral your body craves at midnight.
settings.text:
Magnesium Glycinate - the most bioavailable form of magnesium, chelated with glycine for gentle absorption. Used for centuries to calm the nervous system, ease muscle tension, and restore deep sleep naturally. Zero laxative effect.

WHY IT'S IN: Relaxes muscles and quiets the mind. 200–400 mg before bed.

settings.heading: 03 · RHODIOLA ROSEA
settings.headingcontent: Rhodiola. Born in the harshest climates on Earth.
settings.text:
Harvested from the wild mountain regions of Siberia, Rhodiola Rosea has been used by Viking warriors and Soviet cosmonauts alike. Standardized to 3% Rosavins and 1% Salidroside - the active compounds clinically shown to fight mental fatigue and sharpen focus under pressure.

WHY IT'S IN: Reduces burnout without stimulants. 200–400 mg in the morning.
